pretreatments.description: Mechanical pretreatment: Food processor comminution of winery waste (WW), cotton gin waste (CGW), olive pomace (OP) and juice industry waste (JW) without drying.

Chemical pretreatment with sodium hydroxide (NaOH), sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO_3), sodium chloride (NaCl), citric acid (H_3Cit), acetic acid (AcOH), hydrogen peroxide (H_2O_2), acetone (Me_2CO) and ethanol (EtOH) at varying dosages, process durations (1–24 h) and temperatures (25 and 90 °C).
Thermal pretreatment: Oven drying at 60 °C for cotton gin waste (CGW) and storage at −20 °C for winery waste (WW), olive pomace (OP) and juice industry waste (JW).
Centrifugation: Separation of solid and liquid fractions after pretreatment using centrifugation at 3900 rpm for 15 min.
Filtration: Filtration of solid fractions through a 0.45 μm pore size membrane filter for sCOD and TPH concentration determination.
Storage: Storage of solid samples at −20 °C until further use.
pH measurement: Measurement of the final pH of the slurries after pretreatment.
BMP assays: Conducting Biochemical Methane Potential (BMP) assays to determine the methane potential of pretreated samples.
Analytical methods: Determination of TS, VS, C, H, N, S, and fiber composition (NDF, ADF, ADL) of the substrates and pretreated samples using standard analytical techniques.
Methane volume measurement: Measurement of methane production by volume displacement using an 11.2% KOH solution.
